search_space: All 289 ordered integer pairs (m,n) with -8 <= m <= 8 and -8 <= n <= 8, visited in lexicographic order. Each pair was checked for an evaluable case predicate and inference relation supplied by the quote; none exists. This is an illustrative bounded sweep, not an exhaustive test of arbitrary m and n.
witness_description: No concrete witness is identifiable because neither a mathematical predicate for a “case” nor a derivability relation is supplied.
refutation_explanation: The quote asserts that certain base cases are needed, but it does not define the statement indexed by (m,n), the domains of m and n, or the inference rules denoted by “go from.” Consequently, every candidate pair in the bounded sweep is undecidable from the permitted data, so the sweep cannot establish or refute the claimed necessity.
